description: Defines an abstract class ShapeRenderer responsible for rendering shapes within the MigraDoc PDF generation library, including layout calculations, rendering fill and line styles, and managing shape positioning.

classes.name: ShapeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class for rendering shapes, managing layout, styling, and positioning within the MigraDoc rendering process.

methods.name: InitialLayoutInfo
methods.description: Calculates and returns the initial layout information for the shape, including margins, references, and floating behavior.

methods.name: GetFloating
methods.description: Determines the floating behavior of the shape based on its relative vertical position and wrap style.

methods.name: ShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns the total width of the shape including line width.

methods.name: ShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the shape including line width.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the shape within a given area, determining if it fits based on its height and floating status.

methods.name: FinishLayoutInfo
methods.description: Completes the layout information for the shape, setting content area, margins, alignment, and references.

methods.name: GetHorizontalReference
methods.description: Determines the horizontal reference point for the shape based on its relative horizontal setting.

methods.name: GetVerticalReference
methods.description: Determines the vertical reference point for the shape based on its relative vertical setting.

methods.name: GetVerticalAlignment
methods.description: Returns the vertical alignment of the shape based on its top position.

methods.name: RenderFilling
methods.description: Renders the fill style of the shape within its content area.

methods.name: RenderLine
methods.description: Renders the outline line of the shape.

methods.name: GetHorizontalAlignment
methods.description: Returns the horizontal alignment based on the shape's left position.
